name: dotnet
description: Concern-owned C# and .NET standards for domain modeling, names, responsibilities and operation contracts.

interface.longDescription: Canonical C# roles and operation contracts with separate owners for domain modeling, value construction, shared identifiers, collaborators, payloads, mapping, ORM-independent repository contracts, persistence, result carriers, validation and transports.
